metric_definitions.boundary_touch: nonzero current-cache localization support on any of six crop faces
metric_definitions.sufficient_containment: diagnostic_support_available AND containment_ratio_ge_0.99 AND NOT any_boundary_touch
metric_definitions.margin_voxel: minimum signed full-support-bbox distance to requested crop boundary; negative means support extends outside crop
metric_definitions.margin_mm: axis-specific voxel margin multiplied by reliable canonical NIfTI spacing
metric_definitions.crop_physical_extent_mm: crop voxel count multiplied by canonical NIfTI spacing
metric_definitions.approx_max_extent_mm: maximum pairwise distance among fixed-direction extrema of full support; approximate 3-D Feret diameter
metric_definitions.exact_full_support_containment: cached support voxel count equals full support voxel count; conservative extent-observability sensitivity, not a gate change
metric_definitions.extent_retention_ratio: cached/full fixed-direction approximate maximum extent clipped to [0,1] because extremal-pair approximation is not subset-monotone; descriptive sensitivity, not formal LD calibration
metric_definitions.large_ld_quantiles: descriptive per-visit quantiles on the outcome-free 375-patient overlap

independent_review_addendum.rationale: detect small disconnected distal support that could affect maximum extent despite ratio >= 0.99
